description.value:
Requires: Purification Transformation You master your Purified State, now no longer forcing you into the Berserk Condition. Your Alignment Actively shifts 1 step down (Good > Neutral > Evil) while Purification is active.

Additionally, you deal half your Charisma Modifier on all Techniques and Spells instead of full Charisma Modifier and this form drains 3 Stamina at the end of your turn. You may alternatively choose to lose control to revert to the original version.
